description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Listing/Partner. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the POST partner operation in bulk publication and publication tracking. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the partner operation for bulk publication and publication tracking. Input: request: AutoListRequest. Main fields: WeListForYou: bool. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the partner operation. Search terms: listing partner. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
